project.title: Integrated Youth Wellbeing and Outreach Pilot Programme
project.objective: Design and run a 3‑month pilot that improves psychosocial support, health literacy, and inclusion for at‑risk youth through coordinated outreach and on‑site services.
deliverables: Structured outreach and counselling programme plan for at-risk youth
Weekly youth wellbeing workshop curriculum and materials
On-site oral health awareness and screening session protocol
Data collection and reporting framework for pilot outcomes
Risk and safeguarding procedures for field and on-site activities
Final evaluation report with recommendations for scale-up
constraints: Pilot must be designed to run within existing staff capacity and working hours
All activities must comply with child protection and data privacy regulations
Health-related messaging must align with approved clinical guidelines
Field activities limited to pre-approved community and school locations
Budget only covers low-cost materials and no structural facility changes
Reporting templates must be usable by staff with basic computer literacy

risks.risk: Low engagement from target youth in outreach and workshop activities.
risks.mitigation: Co-design sessions with youth reps, adjust timing and topics based on feedback, and use peer ambassadors to promote events.

risks.risk: Safeguarding or confidentiality breach during counselling or data collection.
risks.mitigation: Standardise procedures, provide refresher training, use anonymised IDs in reports, and restrict access to sensitive records.

risks.risk: Health and oral health messages are inconsistent with clinical standards.
risks.mitigation: Have all materials reviewed by clinical lead and dental clinic supervisor before use; only use approved leaflets and scripts.

risks.risk: Field activities disrupted by weather, access issues, or school timetable changes.
risks.mitigation: Maintain backup indoor locations, agree contingency dates with schools, and keep a flexible weekly schedule.

risks.risk: Data collection is incomplete or of poor quality, limiting evaluation.
risks.mitigation: Simplify forms, provide clear guidance, assign a data focal point, and run weekly checks for missing or inconsistent entries.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures the pilot reflects real needs and encourages sustained participation from diverse youth groups.
All interactions with minors and vulnerable youth must follow strict protection and confidentiality standards.
Social, pastoral, dental, and technical staff must coordinate to deliver coherent support and messaging.
Outreach, school visits, and clinic-based sessions require careful planning to avoid clashes and no-shows.
Consistent records and simple metrics are needed to evaluate the pilot and justify future funding.
Combines psychosocial support with practical health and oral hygiene information tailored to youth.

backlog.task: Map target youth groups and priority locations for the pilot outreach
definition_of_done: List of priority youth groups and locations is documented
Basic profile and needs of each group are summarised
Locations validated with social services manager
Shared with team in channel and stored in project folder

backlog.task: Draft safeguarding and confidentiality procedures for pilot activities
definition_of_done: Written procedures cover one-to-one and group settings
Guidance on consent and information sharing is included
Procedures reviewed by social services manager
Team briefed and acknowledges understanding in channel

backlog.task: Design weekly youth wellbeing workshop curriculum
definition_of_done: Curriculum outlines at least 8 sessions with objectives
Activities and materials are age-appropriate and inclusive
Links to local support services are integrated
Curriculum approved by social services manager

backlog.task: Create simple data collection and attendance templates
definition_of_done: Attendance sheet template created and tested
Session feedback form created with clear questions
Templates are easy to complete on paper or digitally
Team trained on how and when to use each template

backlog.task: Plan and document oral health awareness and screening sessions
definition_of_done: Session flow and roles are documented
List of required materials and equipment is complete
Health education messages align with clinical guidelines
Plan validated by dental clinic supervisor

backlog.task: Develop a simple field visit schedule and routing plan
definition_of_done: All outreach locations plotted with travel times estimated
Weekly visit schedule drafted with buffer time
Risks such as access or weather constraints noted
Schedule shared and agreed with schools and team

backlog.task: Compile and format youth-facing information materials
definition_of_done: Drafts of leaflets and handouts are typed and formatted
Language is clear and suitable for target age groups
Materials incorporate feedback from youth worker and pastoral worker
Final versions stored and ready for printing or digital sharing

backlog.task: Set up record-keeping system for counselling and referrals
definition_of_done: Standard fields for case notes and referrals defined
Process for secure storage and access agreed
System tested with sample entries
Compliance officer signs off on privacy aspects

backlog.task: Coordinate training session on pilot procedures for all staff
definition_of_done: Agenda covers safeguarding, data, and logistics
All roles invited and attendance recorded
Key questions and clarifications documented
Summary and slides shared in channel

backlog.task: Monitor weekly participation and flag emerging risks
definition_of_done: Attendance and feedback data reviewed weekly
Any safeguarding or engagement concerns logged
Adjustments proposed in channel when needed
Summary added to final evaluation inputs

backlog.task: Maintain inventory checklist for oral health session materials
definition_of_done: Checklist of all reusable and consumable items created
Stock levels updated before each session
Missing items flagged at least 2 days in advance
Checklist stored and referenced after each session

backlog.task: Support analysis of pilot data and draft evaluation tables
definition_of_done: Attendance and feedback data compiled into tables
Basic trends and patterns identified
Limitations of data quality noted
Tables shared with team for inclusion in final report

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on pilot scope, objectives, and roles before detailed planning starts.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message sharing the Pilot Programme Overview and inviting clarifications.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final list of target youth groups and locations for the pilot.
Agree role responsibilities for outreach, workshops, and health sessions.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define safeguarding, confidentiality, and record-keeping standards.
threads_plan.trigger: Pastoral worker shares draft safeguarding procedures for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve safeguarding and confidentiality procedures for the pilot.
Decide on the minimum data fields to record for each youth interaction.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalise workshop curriculum and oral health session design.
threads_plan.trigger: Sharing first draft of curriculum pack and oral health protocol.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the initial set of wellbeing workshop topics and sequence.
Confirm which oral health activities are feasible within time and resources.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on field visit schedule, logistics, and coordination with schools.
threads_plan.trigger: Geology technician posts draft visit schedule and map for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock in weekly outreach schedule and confirm with schools and clinics.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review early pilot data, adjust approach, and plan evaluation outputs.
threads_plan.trigger: First monthly summary of attendance and feedback is shared.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on any mid-pilot adjustments and outline key points for the final evaluation.

channel_rituals: Weekly async check-in every Monday summarising planned outreach, workshops, and health sessions.
Midweek quick update thread to flag any safeguarding, logistics, or attendance issues.
End-of-week recap post capturing key numbers, stories, and lessons learned.
Pre-session checklist reminder posts before each oral health or workshop session.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to discuss what worked, what did not, and next steps.
